What is on the cards today

These figures were read on the Individual plan cards at Nov 16, 2026, 1:17 PM America/Caracas (10:17 AM PT). A percent off is the label on that card, measured against Higgsfield's own list price, and is not 65% on every plan.

  • Starter: $19/mo, monthly or billed yearly, 270 credits. No Black Friday cut was shown on the card.
  • Plus annual: $33/mo billed yearly (list $59, labeled −45%, Save $312), 1,200 credits / month.
  • Ultra 3K annual: $50/mo billed yearly (list $129, labeled −60%, Save $948), 3,000 credits / month.
  • Ultra 6K annual: $90/mo billed yearly (list $258, labeled −65%, Save $1,920), 6,000 credits / month.
  • Ultra 9K annual: unknown. The 9K tab did not load a distinct price in this check.
  • Plus monthly: $47 first month, “billed monthly, renews at $59,” labeled 20% off, 1,200 credits / month.
  • Ultra 3K monthly: $79 first month, “billed monthly, renews at $129,” labeled 40% off, 3,000 credits / month.
  • Ultra 6K and 9K monthly first-month prices: unknown in this check.

Plus and Ultra annual cards also say “Unlimited models for 7 days,” only on higgsfield.ai. When that 7-day window starts or ends is unknown. The Business tab still showed Team annual at $45/seat/mo billed yearly and Scale annual at $80/seat/mo billed yearly, and Team monthly $55 / Scale monthly $120; those business figures match the earlier standing discounts and were not a new Black Friday cut in this check.

Unknown: the sale’s calendar end date; the tax-inclusive amount charged at checkout; whether annual sale prices remain after the sale for new buyers or at renewal (the help article How do promo prices work? says a promo price applies to the first payment or the period stated in the offer, then the plan renews at the standard price; the annual cards do not spell out a post-sale price); Ultra 9K annual and the 6K/9K monthly first-month card prices.

The 11.11 sale, now ended

The 11.11 sale is over. First-month Plus and Ultra offers in the deal record ended Nov 15, 2026. The official 11.11 deals post and the earlier sale countdown pointed at that window (the public sale record ended at 2026-11-15T00:00:00Z, which is November 14, 4:00 PM PT). Recorded 11.11 / standing prices, last verified Nov 12 in the deal record, were Plus annual $35/mo and Ultra 3K annual $65/mo, and first-month Plus $47 / Ultra 3K $79. Those annual figures are not the cards shown today. The monthly first-month amounts on today’s cards happen to match the old first-month figures, but this page does not treat them as a continuation of 11.11; they are listed above as current card prices whose end date is unknown.

What you actually save per second

The formula is the same one the rest of VidFare uses for credit plans: plan dollars per month, divided by credits per month, times credits per clip, divided by seconds in the clip, assuming every paid credit is used. Unused credits make the real cost per second higher. Wan 3.0 and Wan 3.0 Prime credit rates on the pricing-page compare table have no tilde. Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, and Hailuo 2.3 are marked approximate on that table, so those rows are estimates. VidFare's Kling 3.0 catalog rows use 7.5 credits per 5 seconds at 720p and 8.75 at 1080p, from Higgsfield's yearly clip counts, not the "~7" / "~8" shorthand.

Each row names the model, resolution, and audio. Audio is not stated on these Higgsfield plan rows. The four rate columns are catalog plan tiers: Plus monthly at the $59/mo list price for 1,200 credits; Plus annual at the $33/mo billed-yearly sale price for 1,200 credits; Ultra 3K monthly at the $129/mo list price for 3,000 credits; Ultra 3K annual at the $50/mo billed-yearly sale price for 3,000 credits. The monthly columns do not use the first-month card prices. Figures are from the price catalog, last checked 2026-11-17. Higgsfield pricing page.

Worked example, Wan 3.0 Prime at 480p on Ultra 3K annual (catalog r081): $50/mo ÷ 3,000 credits = $0.01667/credit; 7.5 credits/clip (5s) → $0.125/clip → $0.0250/s

On Ultra 6K annual at $90/mo for 6,000 credits, the same 5-second 480p Wan 3.0 Prime clip is $0.0225/s. That figure is computed from the card price verified Nov 16, 2026, 1:17 PM America/Caracas (10:17 AM PT) and the catalog credit rate; it is not a row in the price catalog. The Ultra 9K annual card price was not verified in this check (the 9K tab did not load a distinct price), so no 9K dollars-per-second figure is shown.

A first-month monthly price looks cheaper in that first month and much closer to the regular monthly rate over 12 months. For Plus, $47 the first month and $59 for the next 11 months is $58 a month on average. That blend is illustrative; Higgsfield does not print it.

What to recheck

The sale end date, once Higgsfield prints a calendar date or the banner comes down. The tax-inclusive checkout total. Whether annual sale prices stay at $33 and $50 after the sale. The Ultra 9K annual card, and the Ultra 6K/9K monthly first-month cards. Whether the “Unlimited models for 7 days” window is still offered.

Has Higgsfield announced a Black Friday 2026 sale?

Yes. On Nov 16, 2026, 1:17 PM America/Caracas (10:17 AM PT) the official pricing page showed a “Black Friday 65% off” banner and “up to 65% OFF” on the Individual Annual cards. Plus annual was $33/mo billed yearly, and Ultra 3K annual was $50/mo billed yearly. The 11.11 sale is over; its first-month offers ended Nov 15, 2026.

When does the Black Friday sale end?

Unknown. The pricing page shows a countdown (“Up to 65% sale ends in…”) but does not print a calendar end date. This page does not invent one from the animated timer.

What will I pay at checkout?

Unknown. The pricing page says prices exclude VAT and local taxes, which are calculated at checkout. The card prices below are the pre-tax figures shown on the page, not a completed checkout total.

How is dollars per second calculated?

A credit-plan rate is plan price divided by monthly credits, times credits per clip, divided by seconds in that clip. That math assumes every paid credit is used. A figure the vendor marks with a tilde, or that VidFare already stores as an estimate, is labeled an estimate. Seedance 2.5 has no Higgsfield plan credit rate in the catalog, so it has no plan dollars-per-second here. The monthly columns use the catalog list prices (Plus $59/mo, Ultra 3K $129/mo), not the first-month card prices.
